stamina.beastLevelHint: Beasts in one group score the same points in State of Power.

planned.title: Planned hunts
planned.hint: Hunts you do anyway, such as the beasts of the Intel missions. They are paid first.

result.pointsNote: The points are before any bonus, such as Valeria in State of Power. Hunts that are not beasts or Polar Terrors, such as the Bear Hunt, are not counted.

tiles.title: Stamina
tiles.shortNote: The planned hunts need {amount} more stamina than you have. The stamina left pays for no extra hunts.

leftover.title: Stamina left after the planned hunts
leftover.hint: Each row spends all of the stamina left on one kind of hunt.

events.title: Event points
events.hint: Planned is the points of the planned hunts. The last two columns add the hunts that the stamina left pays for.
